description: The SUPPRESS [PRINTING] phrase of the COPY statement (ISO §2023:7.2.3.2: [ SUPPRESS PRINTING ]; §2023:7.2.3.4 GR4 "If the SUPPRESS phrase is specified, library text incorporated as a result of COPY statement processing is not listed"). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 general format is COPY text-name-1 [ { OF | IN } library-name-1 ] [ REPLACING ... ] (§1985:XII.2.2), with no SUPPRESS phrase, and §1985:XII.2.3 SR2 closes it: 'The COPY statement must be preceded by a space and terminated by the separator period'; §2002:7.1.2.3 GR4 has the phrase ('If the SUPPRESS phrase is specified, library text incorporated as a result of COPY statement processing is not listed') and §2002:F.2 states the change, its item 40: 'COPY statement. A SUPPRESS PRINTING phrase is added to the COPY statement to suppress listing of library text incorporated as a result of COPY statement processing.' 2014 keeps it (§2014:7.2.2.3 GR4). VCR row 7.44. The gate is on the phrase, asked by CopyProcessor.GateCopyPhrase (kb/Work PB1601).
display: the SUPPRESS phrase of the COPY statement
vcr: §2002:7.1.2.3 GR4 / §2002:F.2 SUPPRESS [PRINTING]; the edge quoted from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965); VCR row 7.44
